task.title: Update agents/gatekeeper.md pre-scan + intent capture for SQLite-backed workflow
task.description:
Two surgical changes to `agents/gatekeeper.md`:
**1. Pre-Scan procedure (Section B):**
The current `Pre-Scan procedure` block tells gatekeeper to grep: - `docs/trustmybot/GOALS.md → grep for open goals` - `docs/trustmybot/BLUEPRINT.md → grep for phase markers` - `docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.xml → count open tasks`
These files no longer exist after Phase 2 (GOALS/DISCUSSION/BLUEPRINT are gone; specs are .md). Replace the markers block with MCP queries:
``` # Workflow state — MCP queries (replaces file grep) mcp issue_list status=open # any open issues? mcp task_first_actionable # any pending/failed task? ls docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.md 2>/dev/null # surface pending spec files ls docs/trustmybot/snapshots/*.md 2>/dev/null # last review snapshots ```
Note: `issue_list` does NOT exist in current MCP tools (verify by grepping `mcp/trajectory-server/src/tools/`). If it does not exist, the prompt should call `issue_get_with_discussions` for any known-open issue ID, or fall back to `task_first_actionable` (which DOES exist) and reverse-lookup the issue. Architect will add a proper `issue_list` MCP tool in Phase 3 if friction warrants. For now, document the temporary workaround in the prose: "If `issue_list` is unavailable, scan `docs/trustmybot/snapshots/` for recent issue IDs and call `issue_get` per ID."
Update the **Inventory block format** lines: - Remove: `Open goals: ` - Replace `Open tasks: ` with: `Open issues: ` `Pending tasks: ` `Spec files: `
**2. Section C.1 Branch ID Proposal — append a Step 5:**
After "4. Pass the confirmed branch_id in the Task tool prompt", add:
``` 5. Open or resume the MCP issue for this work and record the human's intent as a discussion entry: - If no open issue exists: call issue_create(objective=<short summary of the request>). - In either case: call discussion_append(issue_id, author='human', kind='intent', body_md=<the verbatim Human request>) AND discussion_append(issue_id, author='gatekeeper', kind='note', body_md='Routed to architect on branch_id <the branch_id>'). Pass the issue_id in the architect spawn prompt: "architect, plan and execute on branch_id 'feat/foo-bar' for issue <issue_id>" This guarantees architect can append further discussion entries and create the tasks under a real issue row. ```
**3. Section G. Workflow vs. Direct Mode:**
Update the Workflow Mode trigger: Old: "default when GOALS.md has unclosed goals and the request relates to them" New: "default when MCP issue_resume returns an open issue OR the request implies multi-file coordinated work"
Keep all other sections (A Role Statement, C Routing Table, C.1 Branch ID Proposal Steps 1-4, D Agent-Creator Flow, E No Auto-Action Discipline, F Direct Operations, Communication Style, Chain-of-Thought Discipline) intact. Phase 1 already added the branch_id proposal block (C.1) — leave it alone except for the new Step 5.
Cite `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md` once near the top of Section B (so gatekeeper can answer "where do task specs live now?" without a grep).

files.file: Surgical edits per description: pre-scan markers block, inventory block format, Section C.1 step 5, Section G workflow trigger, single SPEC-FORMAT.md citation. Do not rewrite untouched sections.

task.commit:
🚪 refactor(gatekeeper): pre-scan + intent capture via MCP for Phase 2 SQLite-backed workflow
Pre-scan no longer greps GOALS.md / BLUEPRINT.md / tasks/*.xml — those files are gone after Phase 2. Now queries MCP issue_resume + task_first_actionable; surfaces .md spec files and snapshots.
